ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
 q_str varchar2(1000);
BEGIN

 if :ctrl_block.site_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_block.site_id');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 

 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 q_str := ' site_id = :ctrl_block.site_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 
 
 if :ctrl_block.s_termination ='N' then
 q_str := Rtrim(q_str) || ' and (:ctrl_block.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_block.chp_sysdate+1))';
 else
 q_str := Rtrim(q_str) || ' and staff_no not in (select staff_no from employees where employees.staff_no = fixed_site_staff.staff_no and :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate not between employees.eff_date and employees.term_date)';
 End if;

-- message(q_str);pause;
 set_block_property('fixed_site_staff',DEFAULT_WHERE,q_str);
 go_block('fixed_site_staff');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10'; -- IM 362
 execute_query;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0'; -- IM 362
 set_block_property('fixed_site_staff',DEFAULT_WHERE,'');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.staff_no != :fixed_site_staff.staff_no or
 :global.site_id != :fixed_site_staff.site_id then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C06C10',
 :fixed_site_staff.staff_no||','||
 :fixed_site_staff.site_id||
 ',','D',chk);
 
 end if;

IF :global.staff_no = :fixed_site_staff.staff_no and
 :global.site_id = :fixed_site_staff.site_id 
THEN
 null;
ELSE
 if :fixed_site_staff.staff_no is not null and
 :fixed_site_staff.site_id is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM fixed_site_staff
 WHERE staff_no = :fixed_site_staff.staff_no and
 site_id = :fixed_site_staff.site_id ;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C06C10',
 :fixed_site_staff.staff_no||','||
 :fixed_site_staff.site_id||
 ',','U',chk);

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C06C10',
 :fixed_site_staff.staff_no||','||
 :fixed_site_staff.site_id||
 ',','U',chk);

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

begin
 
 -- Jairam added per IM 5204 just to make sure its showing 5015 error if eff date entered is less than current date. on 13-apr-2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if; 
-- above code by jairam
 
 
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 
 if eff_date < trunc(v_local_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(v_local_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.SITE_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.site_id',action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_site_id',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.s_termination',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_site_id',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_STAFF
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select staff_no,Initcap(last_name||' '||first_name) name, vmc.description 
from employees e,valid_master_codes vmc
where e.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 e.dept_id = vmc.code (+) and
 vmc.code_type (+) = 'DEPTS' and 
sysdate between e.eff_date and nvl(e.term_date,sysdate+1) 
order by last_name
